pages.text: The elite soldier of the serpon combat team and the legion's heavy line-breaker, pressing forward with a polearm and a charge.

You can summon this elite by ritual, or borrow its aid for a while with a $(l:supreme/items/serpon_crown_focus)Serpon Crown Focus$().$(br)You can right-click your Serpon Intruder with $(item)Blaze Powder$() or a $(item)Blaze Rod$() to heal it.
